document:3:402:0.text:
Effect: Rapidly neutralizes toxins and effectively relieves coma caused by food poisoning.
Preparation: Add <style="highlight">dragonblood leaf</style>, <style="highlight">waxweed</style>, and <style="highlight">zen orchid</style>. Simmer briefly to finish.
document:3:402:0.source_cn:
疗效：能够迅速中和毒素，有效缓解因食物中毒引起的昏迷症状。
炼制方法：依次加入<style="highlight">龙血灌木叶</style>、<style="highlight">白蜡草</style>、<style="highlight">清心兰</style>，短暂熬煮后即可制成。
